name: swarm-feedback
description: Review and grade prompts submitted by SWARM Automation installations.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/with-dynamodb.mjs npm run test:integration:raw -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
